title: A Potential Peace Deal With the Taliban

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对精选采访进行直播，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费阅读权限，畅享我们的所有新闻。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是...

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the United States appeared to have finally reached an agreement with the Taliban that would begin to end America's longest-running war in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，美国似乎终于与塔利班达成了一项协议，这将开始结束美国在阿富汗历时最长的战争。

sentences.en: That agreement followed months of private negotiations in Qatar between the two sides.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，双方已经在卡塔尔进行了数月的闭门谈判。

sentences.en: We spoke to my colleague, Mujib Mashal, about what he learned from being there.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了我的同事穆吉卜·马沙尔，聊了聊他在现场的所见所闻。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, September 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月3日，星期二。

sentences.en: After the extraordinary sacrifice of blood and treasure, the American people are weary of war without victory.
sentences.zh: 在付出了巨大的鲜血和财富代价后，美国人民已经厌倦了这场没有胜利的战争。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: military and diplomatic leaders are moving ahead on the Afghanistan strategy.
sentences.zh: 军事和外交领导人正在推进阿富汗战略。

sentences.en: We are a partner and a friend, but we will not dictate to the Afghan people how to live or how to govern their own complex society.
sentences.zh: 我们是伙伴也是朋友，但我们不会对阿富汗人民的生活方式或如何治理他们复杂社会的事务指手画脚。

sentences.en: Afghan security forces are battling a resurgent Taliban that's launching attacks around the country.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗安全部队正在与卷土重来的塔利班作战，后者在全国各地发动袭击。

sentences.en: We are not nation-building again.
sentences.zh: 我们不会再次进行国家建设。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: and the Taliban appear to be making progress toward a peace deal in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 与塔利班似乎正在朝着达成阿富汗和平协议取得进展。

sentences.en: My administration is holding constructive talks with a number of Afghan groups, including the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 我的政府正在与包括塔利班在内的许多阿富汗派别进行建设性会谈。

sentences.en: The news that was coming out of Doha, which is where these talks are taking place, is that the framework is in place.
sentences.zh: 从多哈（这些会谈的举行地）传出的消息是，框架已经到位。

sentences.en: Negotiators have agreed on a framework for a potential pact that could finally end.
sentences.zh: 谈判代表已经就一项潜在协议的框架达成一致，该协议最终可能结束……

sentences.en: 17 years after a coalition chased the Taliban out of Kabul,
sentences.zh: 在联军将塔利班赶出喀布尔17年后，

sentences.en: Washington's envoy reaching a tentative deal on a roadmap.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿特使就路线图达成了一项初步协议。

sentences.en: We do not know whether we'll achieve an agreement.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道能否达成协议。

sentences.en: But we do know that after two decades of war,
sentences.zh: 但我们知道，经过二十年的战争，

sentences.en: the hour has come to at least try for peace.
sentences.zh: 至少尝试争取和平的时机已经成熟。

sentences.en: And the other side would like to do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 另一方也愿意这样做。

sentences.en: It's time.
sentences.zh: 是时候了。

sentences.en: Mujib, you've been assigned to cover these landmark negotiations.
sentences.zh: 穆吉卜，你被委派去报道这些具有里程碑意义的谈判。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could walk us through how you actually do that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能否向我们介绍一下你是如何具体开展这项工作的。

sentences.en: So for the past few months, I've been every few weeks,
sentences.zh: 所以在过去的几个月里，我每隔几周，

sentences.en: I've been going to Doha, the small Gulf state of Qatar.
sentences.zh: 就会去一次多哈，即海湾小国卡塔尔。

sentences.en: And it's an excruciating trip because there are a lot of tensions in the region.
sentences.zh: 这是一次痛苦的旅行，因为该地区存在很多紧张局势。

sentences.en: In Saudi Arabia, there's a big blockade against Qatar.
sentences.zh: 在沙特阿拉伯，对卡塔尔实施了全面的封锁。

sentences.en: So a trip that would take two, three hours, it takes me a full day of travel through Istanbul to get there.
sentences.zh: 因此，原本只需两三个小时的行程，我却需要经由伊斯坦布尔花上一整天的时间才能到达。

sentences.en: But once we get there, the routine is largely similar.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我们到达那里，日常流程基本上都是一样的。

sentences.en: The American diplomats stay in these sort of luxury hotels.
sentences.zh: 美国外交官住在那种豪华酒店里。

sentences.en: The Taliban, a lot of them have houses there because they've been based there for a long time.
sentences.zh: 塔利班成员中有很多在那里有房子，因为他们已经在那里驻扎了很长时间。

sentences.en: But in the mornings, they all come to this small diplomatic club.
sentences.zh: 但在早晨，他们都会来到这个小型外交俱乐部。

sentences.en: And what happens is as soon as you walk in, they take your phones away.
sentences.zh: 情况是这样的：你一走进去，他们就会把你的手机没收。

sentences.en: And you walk through scanners and, you know, you put your notebooks or anything you have through the scanner.
sentences.zh: 你穿过安检扫描仪，你知道的，把你带的笔记本或任何东西都过一下安检。

sentences.en: And it's this beautiful marble floor, small club.
sentences.zh: 这里有美丽的大理石地面，是一个很小的俱乐部。

sentences.en: And members of the media were barely allowed access to the diplomatic club.
sentences.zh: 媒体成员几乎不被允许进入外交俱乐部。

sentences.en: It's a lot of sort of cat and mouse.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一场猫捉老鼠的游戏。

sentences.en: Sometimes we're actually kicked out.
sentences.zh: 有时我们实际上被赶了出去。

sentences.en: Sometimes we make our way in, we negotiate.
sentences.zh: 有时我们设法进去，进行谈判。

sentences.en: And then one of the American diplomats helps in and tells the Qatari guards, it's okay for us to be there as long as we stay in this corner cafe.
sentences.zh: 然后其中一位美国外交官会进来帮忙，告诉卡塔尔警卫，只要我们呆在这个角落的咖啡馆里，我们在那里就是可以的。

sentences.en: They go upstairs to this more private space where the negotiations happen.
sentences.zh: 他们上楼去那个更私密的、进行谈判的空间。

sentences.en: So I usually just make my way to the cafe every time I take the same seat at the cafe, which has a view of the lobby.
sentences.zh: 所以我通常只是去咖啡馆，每次都在咖啡馆里坐在同一个座位上，那个座位能看到大厅。

sentences.en: So at least I have a view of when the sessions have ended, you know, who is walking around.
sentences.zh: 所以至少我能看到会议什么时候结束，你知道的，谁在走动。

sentences.en: I have a good view.
sentences.zh: 我能看得很清楚。

sentences.en: And then most of my day is spent, you know, doing crossword puzzles, reading a book, ordering a lot of coffee after coffee.
sentences.zh: 然后我的一天大部分时间都在做填字游戏、看书、一杯又一杯地疯狂点咖啡。

sentences.en: And then sort of I have an eye for the negotiations routine as to when they're going to take their break.
sentences.zh: 接着我会留意谈判的常规流程，看他们什么时候休息。

sentences.en: And then I kind of try to plan my bathroom break around that.
sentences.zh: 然后我试着围绕这个时间来安排我去洗手间的时间。

sentences.en: I may naturally run into one of them in the lobby.
sentences.zh: 我可能会在大厅里自然地碰巧遇到他们中的某个人。

sentences.en: It's a lot of reading faces, a lot of reading, you know, what mood is the chief negotiator in as he walks out?
sentences.zh: 这需要观察很多人的脸色，揣摩很多心思，比如：首席谈判代表走出来时心情如何？

sentences.en: Are they, you know, standing in a corner?
sentences.zh: 他们是不是站在角落里？

sentences.en: Are the hands waving?
sentences.zh: 是不是在挥舞双手？

sentences.en: And are they angry at each other?
sentences.zh: 他们是不是在生彼此的气？

sentences.en: Is somebody walking out in anger?
sentences.zh: 是不是有人气冲冲地走出来？

sentences.en: But both sides have been really, really disciplined during these eight and nine months.
sentences.zh: 但在这八九个月里，双方都非常非常克制。

sentences.en: So it's tricky work trying to understand what's actually going on upstairs behind closed doors.
sentences.zh: 所以要想弄清楚闭门会议的楼上到底发生了什么，是一项棘手的工作。

sentences.en: On the American side, there's a lot more interaction.
sentences.zh: 在美方这边，互动要多得多。

sentences.en: And they engage with the media more.
sentences.zh: 他们更多地与媒体接触。

sentences.en: But on the Taliban side, these are insurgent leaders that we had only known names of for years.
sentences.zh: 但在塔利班这边，这些都是我们多年来只闻其名的叛乱分子领袖。

sentences.en: It's the first time we're seeing their faces.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次见到他们的面孔。

sentences.en: It's the first time we're in the same space with them.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次与他们处于同一空间。

sentences.en: Some of them, it's for the first time they're using phones in years because they were afraid of being, you know, tracked down and hit by a drone.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人是多年来第一次使用手机，因为他们害怕被追踪并遭到无人机袭击。

sentences.en: So it's in that context that one needs to rely on a lot of creative ways of creating comfort and creating truSt.
sentences.zh: 正是在这种背景下，人们需要依靠许多富有创造力的方法来营造舒适感和建立信任。

sentences.en: And sometimes that means lucky breaks also.
sentences.zh: 有时这也意味着一些幸运的机缘。

sentences.en: I mean, for a couple of nights in one of the rounds, I happened to have a room just above the room of their chief negotiator.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在其中一轮谈判的几个晚上里，我碰巧住到了他们首席谈判代表房间正上方的房间。

sentences.en: And one of the other negotiators was leaving session.
sentences.zh: 当时另一位谈判代表正要离开会场，

sentences.en: And I said, hey, it would be great if we could have a conversation.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，嘿，如果我们能聊聊就太好了。

sentences.en: And he said, where are you staying?
sentences.zh: 他说，你住哪儿？

sentences.en: And I told him the room number.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了他房间号。

sentences.en: He was like, oh, that's just above from us.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，那就在我们正上方啊。

sentences.en: So maybe I'll find you there.
sentences.zh: 那我可能会去那里找你。

sentences.en: And it was late in the evening, and I was typing an online version of the story, and there was a knock on the door.
sentences.zh: 那天很晚了，我正在打这篇报道的网络版，突然有人敲门。

sentences.en: And I was in shorts, and I quickly put on a shirt, and I buttoned up a few of the buttons, and I opened the door.
sentences.zh: 当时我穿着短裤，赶紧套上一件衬衫，扣上几个纽扣，然后把门打开了。

sentences.en: It was one of the negotiators standing in the doorway with a plate of cookies and dried fruit.
sentences.zh: 门口站着一位谈判代表，手里端着一盘饼干和果脯。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He said, I'm away from home.
sentences.zh: 他说，我背井离乡，

sentences.en: You guys are away from home, and one of our friends dropped off some cookies and dried fruit, and I wanted to share.
sentences.zh: 你们也背井离乡，我们的一个朋友送来了一些饼干和果脯，我想拿来分享一下。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was surprised.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很惊讶。

sentences.en: And I said, well, sir, come on in.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，先生，请进。

sentences.en: And he came into the room, and he sat in one of the couches.
sentences.zh: 他走进房间，坐在其中一张沙发上。

sentences.en: And for a second, I thought, I can't tell this guy.
sentences.zh: 有一秒钟我心想，我不能跟这家伙说：

sentences.en: I'm sorry, sir.
sentences.zh: 对不起，先生，

sentences.en: I have to file a story.
sentences.zh: 我得去发稿了。

sentences.en: New York is waiting on a story.
sentences.zh: 纽约还在等我的稿子呢。

sentences.en: He's like, this is, when else do you get an opportunity for a midnight conversation with one of the most senior leaders of the Taliban?
sentences.zh: 他说，什么时候你还能有机会和塔利班最高层领导人之一进行午夜交谈？

sentences.en: When do you indeed?
sentences.zh: 可不是吗？

sentences.en: When do you indeed?
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And so I just closed my laptop, and I sat down.
sentences.zh: 于是我关上笔记本电脑，坐了下来。

sentences.en: And I noticed he was staring at the ceiling as we were having this conversation.
sentences.zh: 我注意到我们在谈话时，他一直盯着天花板。

sentences.en: And so we're talking about, you know, the political reality of Afghanistan, what these negotiations could mean for ending the war, and he's not making eye contact.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在谈论阿富汗的政治现实，这些谈判对于结束战争意味着什么，而他却没有与我进行眼神交流。

sentences.en: A couple times I had talked to him before, he was totally fine, and now he's not making eye contact.
sentences.zh: 之前我和他交谈过几次，他都很正常，现在他却不看我了。

sentences.en: During this conversation, he slowly reached out for a pillow, and he put it on my knees because I was wearing shorts.
sentences.zh: 在谈话过程中，他慢慢地伸手拿了一个枕头，把它放在我的膝盖上，因为我穿着短裤。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Just gently, he said, anything above the knees is private.
sentences.zh: 他只是温和地说，膝盖以上都是隐私。

sentences.en: What he meant was I was showing too much skin.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是我的皮肤露得太多了。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: So for the next 40 minutes or so, I'm holding this pillow on my lap, covering my knees as we continue a serious conversation about the political future of Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 所以在接下来的大约40分钟里，我一直把枕头抱在腿上，盖住膝盖，同时我们继续就阿富汗的政治未来进行严肃的对话。

sentences.en: This is a shadowy movement.
sentences.zh: 这是一个隐秘的组织。

sentences.en: We don't know a lot about the leaders of these groups, and here's an opportunity to try to understand what do they think?
sentences.zh: 我们对这些集团的领导人知之甚少，而现在正是一个试图了解他们的想法的机会。

sentences.en: What are their feelings about this stuff?
sentences.zh: 他们对此事的感受如何？

sentences.en: So it has much been an education in trying to understand what context they're coming with to these talks and these negotiations.
sentences.zh: 因此，这在很大程度上是一次学习过程，试图理解他们带着怎样的背景来到这些会谈和谈判桌前。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's talk about what these negotiations that you're trying so hard to understand are actually about.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们来谈谈你费尽心思想要了解的这些谈判究竟是关于什么的。

sentences.en: What exactly is being negotiated there in Qatar?
sentences.zh: 在卡塔尔谈判的究竟是什么？

sentences.en: So the most fundamental framework is this.
sentences.zh: 最基础的框架是这样的：

sentences.en: There has to be an American troop withdrawal.
sentences.zh: 美国必须撤军。

sentences.en: There are about 14,000 American troops and a few thousand NATO allies in the country right now.
sentences.zh: 目前国内大约有14,000名美军和数千名北约盟军。

sentences.en: The Taliban have said the cornerstone of a peace deal has to be the withdrawal of those foreign troops.
sentences.zh: 塔利班已经表示，和平协议的基石必须是这些外国军队的撤出。

sentences.en: In return for that withdrawal, the Americans are asking assurances from the Taliban that they will not harbor international terror groups like Al-Qaeda again.
sentences.zh: 作为对撤军的回报，美方要求塔利班保证他们不会再次收容像“基地”组织这样的国际恐怖集团。

sentences.en: The other thing that the Americans have gotten the Taliban to basically agree to is once a schedule for the withdrawal of American troops is announced,
sentences.zh: 美国让塔利班基本同意的另一件事是，一旦宣布美军撤离时间表，

sentences.en: the Taliban will sit down with other Afghans, including the country's government, to iron out the political future after the U.S.
sentences.zh: 塔利班将与包括该国政府在内的其他阿富汗各方坐下来，敲定美军结束军事存在之后的政治未来。

sentences.en: ends its military presence.
sentences.zh: 结束军事存在。

sentences.en: The Taliban have all along said they would negotiate with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 塔利班一直表示，他们将首先与美国就外国占领问题进行谈判，然后才会转入讨论阿富汗未来命运的政治问题。

sentences.en: first about the foreign occupation, and then they will move into talking about the political questions of what happens to the future of Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 这意味着权力分享，这意味着修改宪法，这意味着诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: That means power sharing, that means changes in the Constitution, that means things like that.
sentences.zh: 但重要的是，所有这些讨论都将在倒计时中进行，因为美军的撤离已经开始。

sentences.en: But what is important is all of those discussions will be happening under a ticking clock because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，当这些谈判开始时，塔利班说：我们希望你们在几个月内撤军。

sentences.en: withdrawal would have started.
sentences.zh: 而美国则说：不，不，不，我们需要至少几年时间，三年左右或类似的时间。

sentences.en: So when these negotiations started, the Taliban are saying, we want you out in months.
sentences.zh: 然后塔利班说：不，我们就想让你们在几个月内离开。

sentences.en: And the U.S.
sentences.zh: 接着，美国不得不将军事专家带到谈判桌前，向塔利班实际解释，从后勤上讲，结束长达18年的军事存在

sentences.en: was saying, no, no, no, we need a couple years at least, three years or something like that.
sentences.zh: 根本不可能在几个月内完成。

sentences.en: And then the Taliban are like, no, we want you out in months.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场讨价还价的谈判，我们认为他们达成的最后时间表大约是15或16个月，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And then the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国愿意在某种程度上妥协于较短的时间表，因为美国也有国内考量。

sentences.en: had to bring military experts to the negotiating table to actually explain to the Taliban how logistically ending an 18-year military presence
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统希望尽快撤军，甚至在这些谈判开始之前塔利班就这么要求了。

sentences.en: simply cannot happen in a matter of months.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗是一场彻底的灾难。
